rows.en:
No… S-stop it!

Brother, Sister… …Ngh… nngh… Stop it, Father!!

…Abnormal brainwave activity detected! Lucifard, hang on! Lucifard!!

…[HERO2]!!
Humanity still knows nothing of this battle fought in Jupiter's orbit. Nor that it was the prologue to Earth's greatest crisis…
Soon after, two shooting stars streaked from Jupiter toward Earth… And now, the battle has begun!
Curse you, Takeshi Hongo… no, Kamen Rider! To think you would defy our Shocker…
Leader!! I'll crush your schemes, no matter what! Prepare yourself.
Leader!! I will crush your schemes, no matter what! Prepare yourself.
Who are you? Defying our Shocker… You don't know your place!

Are you the one modifying innocent people however you please?

I won't forgive anyone who does that! Treating people like mere tools… I will never allow that!

Are you the one modifying innocent people however you please?

I won't forgive anyone who does that! Treating people like mere tools… I will never allow that!
Talk all you like! But can you defeat the cyborgs that are our Shocker's pride?
Shocker secret base confirmed… Scan results show no particular danger.
Shocker secret base confirmed… Scan results show no particular danger.

…!? So this is their base?

It'd be trouble if they found us now… We'd better get away from here for the moment, before their reinforcements arrive.
Scan results… Multiple cyborgs confirmed inside. [HERO2], there are too many of them!
Nngh… Takeshi Hongo… no, Kamen Rider! You'll pay for this!! Hoah…
Come out! Leader!!
Damn… Shocker abandoned this base, didn't they?

…!?

Warning, abnormal vibration detected! This is…!?
It's a self-destruct device! They're going to blow up this base!
Roger! Evacuating while deploying a defense field. Get ready…
What incredible power… Have I really become a cyborg?
Looks like it… Your combat ability is incredible, no doubt about it. I wouldn't want you as an enemy.
By the way… are you two cyborgs too?

Cyborgs, huh…

Unfortunately, no, we're not. Well, in the sense that we aren't ordinary humans, maybe we're the same as you…
Come to think of it, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Takeshi Hongo, a student at Jonan University.

I'm [HERO2] Sakomizu.

A lot has happened… My purpose has changed, but I've finally managed to come down to Earth.
Earth…? Are you saying… you came here from another planet?
I may not look it, but I'm an Earthling. Though… like I said before, I'm not "ordinary"…
Um… Mr. Hongo?
Uh, and you are?

Oh, forgive me for not introducing myself sooner. My name is [HERO4].

Why did they perform cyborg surgery on you? What kind of organization is Shocker?

I don't have the faintest idea myself…

All I know is that the Leader of Shocker said cyborgs would move the world, and that he would be the one controlling those cyborgs…

World conquest using cyborgs…

I will never forgive anyone who modifies humans in a way that ignores the human heart!

But… it's exactly the kind of thing those people would come up with, isn't it? Maybe…
[HERO2]… Are you looking for someone?
Yes. [HERO2] is…
[HERO4]!! You don't need to say anything more than that!
Y-yes! I'm sorry…
Hongo, I'm sorry, but…

No, if you don't want to talk about it, that's fine.

I won't ask who you are anymore.

You fought alongside me… That's enough for me!

I've found allies I can count on in the fight against them… For me, no longer human, that's my one and only consolation!
…Hongo.
Takeshi Hongo, modified by Shocker, the evil secret society plotting to conquer the world… thus became the warrior of justice, Kamen Rider.
And Hongo resolved to wage a lonely battle against the armies of evil alongside the mysterious man who had rescued him from his plight: Lucifard of the jet-black Roaring Steel.
The fierce battle between Shocker and Kamen Rider begins here…
Earth is being targeted! Even now, from among the thousands of stars drifting in space, the dreadful hands of invasion are reaching out…
Learning of this, humanity formed two organizations by UN resolution to counter enemies from outside.
The Terrestrial Defence Force, known as the TDF…
The Space Investigation and Defence Organization, known as SIDO…
The TDF mainly covered the Earth sphere, and SIDO the region from Mars to the outer Solar System, sharing the duty of defending Earth.
So there's still no word from the NO-0117-A Space Fortress Naager that launched from Earth?
Well… communications remain cut off, so for now, I really can't say…
What in the world has happened!? That's the most advanced fortress ship there is, the pride of SIDO… no, the pride of all humanity…
I'm terribly sorry. We're doing everything in our power to search for NO-0117-A…
Staff Officer Kitakura, this is your responsibility! I'll be considering what to do with you… understood?
Er… yes, sir…
Director! Dr. Hinata from the biochemistry team says there's some information you ought to hear…
Dr. Hinata…?

Director… It's about the matter of Number Ten…

There are signs that it may not be a mere planet. According to my research, it may be a giant intelligent life-form.

Ha ha ha… Dr. Hinata, I'd appreciate it if you didn't make jokes.

An intelligent life-form? Do you seriously believe a creature that huge could exist in this universe?
I do. That is, without a doubt…

That's enough!

Aboard that ship is Director Sakomizu, SIDO's highest authority, along with his family!

At a time when we of the TDF must do everything we can to ensure their safety, you'd have me say Number Ten is not a planet but a giant creature?

That the most advanced fortress ship was eaten by that giant creature? That this is why communications are cut and its whereabouts unknown? Is that how you'd have me explain it?

…………

Then is there some other reason? Are you saying you have a convincing explanation!?

If my theory is correct…

that is… a symbiont that should become the first step in a dramatic evolution for us, the humanity of the space age.

This is distasteful…

As of this moment… you are no longer needed at our TDF! Pack your things…
Director…
Three years later… Number Ten suddenly vanished. Just as when it was discovered, it left no trace at all, as though no such star had ever existed in the first place…
Scientists all over the world argued over every theory about Number Ten's true nature, but time passed without a definitive answer…
Invasions of Earth from outer space began to intensify, and the TDF and SIDO were merged to unify their chain of command…
With the new TDF at the top, various defense and investigation organizations were formed across the Earth.
But humanity had not yet noticed that the seeds of evil were sprouting not only among enemies from outside, but on Earth itself.

Dr. Hinata!

The Nojimazaki Marine Biology Laboratory reports that a new species of microorganism was found mixed in the seawater at Shirahama Beach.
A new species of microorganism?
Yes… They say they've sent a sample, and they'd like you to examine it, Doctor.
That'd be Vol, wouldn't it? It must be a microorganism infested with archaeal cells.

It can't be!?

Father, are you saying it's Vol cells, a kind of archaeal cell from an extraterrestrial life-form?

That's right… I hear Number Ten suddenly vanished, didn't it?

If your theory is right… then Number Ten, being an intelligent life-form, must have moved somehow.

In that case… it wouldn't be strange for Vol, the archaeal cells that govern Number Ten, to have come to this Earth…
Dr. Hinata…

Hmm… Let's wait for the sample and examine it in detail…

It might really be Number Ten's Vol cells… If so…

U00173: 見つかるとことだ read as 見つかると事だ ('it'd be trouble if they found us')
U00189: 迫水 is hard-coded in the JP rather than [HERO1]; rendered '[HERO2] Sakomizu' as in the source
U00193: kept 'Mr. Hongo' for the heroine's polite -san
U00213: NO-0117-A Space Fortress Naager (the Japanese uses Latin 'Naager' here; glossary 宇宙要塞艦ナガー = Space Fortress Naager)
U00238: 青生 read as 寄生 (infested/parasitized)
U00210/U00211: kept the source's English spelling 'Defence'
omissions_kept: U00219/U00221/U00227: Dr. Hinata's gender is not established in this batch; worded without pronouns
